business_summary.text: Dynacons Systems & Solutions Limited is a system integrator providing private cloud, data center infrastructure, AI-ready infrastructure, cyber security, digital workplace solutions, and managed services to BFSI, government, PSUs, and enterprise segments.

call_points.text: Management expects growth momentum to continue despite Q1FY27 revenue dip
Revenue timing issues due to OEM and supply chain lead-times
Order book stood close to ₹3,000 crores as of May 30, 2026.
Full-year EBITDA margin improved to 10.2% reflecting structural improvements in solution mix.

operating_notes.text: RBI order of ₹750.82 Cr including GST covers servers, unified native storage, SAN switches, racks and software licences with 5 years of support.
RBI is building a greenfield next-generation data centre at Bhubaneswar, Odisha, with a separate AI Cloud integration provision.
Listed in Financial Times High-Growth Companies Asia-Pacific 2026 for the fifth time.
Order book stood close to ₹3,000 crores as of May 30, 2026.

₹125.88 Cr (excl. GST) Central Bank of India order covers x86 private cloud, NVIDIA H200 Blackwell GPU infrastructure, Kubernetes container platform and 24x7 managed services at DC/DR sites over 5 years.
Order book contains several multi-year engagements with embedded support, managed services, and recurring revenue components
Bidding pipeline stood at approximately ₹6,650 crores across data center and cloud, networking, workplace solutions, and managed services
As-a-Service business growth has led to increase in fixed assets to ₹158 Cr
Secured ₹137.15 Cr (incl. GST) order from the Supreme Court of India for SITC of 728 servers at 728 District Courts with 3 years support.

timeline.summary: On 4 May 2026 Dynacons said it won a ₹750.82 Cr (incl. GST) five-year order from the Reserve Bank of India for private cloud infrastructure at its data centres.
Dynacons announced its fifth inclusion in the Financial Times High-Growth Companies Asia-Pacific ranking on May 13, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹402.45 Cr (+22.4% YoY), net profit ₹18.99 Cr (+4.3% YoY).

Dynacons Systems & Solutions Limited shared the audio recording of its analyst/investor meet on audited FY26 results (Q4 & FY) held June 02, 2026, at 16:30 IST via www.dynacons.com/Investor-Call-Audio-02062026.mp3, signed by Pooja Patwa (Mem No. 60986) and Girish Patwa.
Shirish M. Anjaria, on behalf of promoters and persons acting in concert, declared no encumbrance on shares as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Dynacons was ranked 63 in TIME’s India’s Fastest-Growing Companies of 2026 on June 4, 2026.
Dynacons Systems & Solutions hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings call on June 2, 2026, reporting strong order intake and a near ₹3,000 Cr order book.

2026-06-08: Dynacons won a ₹125.88 Cr (excl. GST) order from Central Bank of India for private cloud expansion, NVIDIA H200 Blackwell GPU servers and a Kubernetes container platform, with 5-year managed services.
August 14, 2026: Dynacons Systems & Solutions Limited held Q1FY27 earnings call reporting strong order book of ₹3,104 Cr and EBITDA margin
Dynacons Systems & Solutions received the Spirit of Partnership Award at Motadata Amplify Mumbai 2026 on October 15, 2026.
Dynacons Systems & Solutions secured a ₹137.15 Cr (incl. GST) 3-year contract from the Supreme Court of India for 728 district court servers.
Dynacons Systems & Solutions received recognition as a Leading Mid-Corporate of India 2026 by Dun & Bradstreet.
